metadata.description:
# Claude Panel
A dockable chat window inside REAPER. Each message carries a text description of what is selected (tracks, items, MIDI notes, time selection, markers), so Claude can answer about the project in front of you.
It talks to Claude through the Claude Code command line (claude -p), signed in with your Claude plan. No API key is used.
With Node.js installed, Claude can also act on the project: it runs ReaScript in REAPER through an MCP server shipped with the panel. Every script is one undo step. This can be switched off, or set to ask before each change.
## Requirements
- ReaImGui 0.9 or newer - Claude Code installed and signed in - Node.js 16 or newer, for acting on the project
## Notes
- Send button or Ctrl+Enter sends - Press Settings, then Test, to check that the claude command is found - Claude can show choice dialogs (buttons or checkboxes)
